verdict.rationale: Digits is an accounting/general-ledger product, so locking closed periods is a fair question for it. The evidence describes an agentic month-end close workflow, close quality checks and auto-booking, but nothing documents locking closed periods or requiring an explicit reopen before prior-period numbers can change. Those close features are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can lock closed periods so prior-period numbers cannot change without an explicit reopening
